title: helenia autumnalis
intro: Helenia autumnalis, commonly known as Autumn Gentian or Gentianella, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Helenia autumnalis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
